$comment: Shadow Trials: an endless ladder of practice fortresses. Tier t uses Keep min(15, 1 + floor((t-1)/tiersPerHall)) (the last Keep level in hall.json); past it (tier 60), defenses grow by powerGrowthPerTier per tier. Rewards are paid once, on the first clear of the next tier. taskMaxGrowth (economy E27, 2026-11-13): a 'clear N Trial tiers' task is offered only while the next N tiers are at or below the player's Keep and their growth past tier 60 is at most this (1.1236 = the first two tiers past the Keep ladder); a judgement, not measured against players.

modifiers.name: Elite Garrison
modifiers.description: Defenses are 20% tougher and hit 20% harder.
